metadata.case_name: LAM YAN FOO v. PUN WAI HONG AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_after: Retired April 1995; School bus driver (Lingnan College) for 4 months in early 1996

injuries.description: He suffered 2 perforations of the small bowel and one perforation of the large bowel.
source: He suffered 2 perforations of the small bowel and one perforation of the large bowel.

injuries.description: that, as a result of the abdominal wound and necessary resectioning of the Plaintiffs bowel, the Plaintiff suffered from extensive adhesions of the bowel which had caused a partial bowel obstruction.
source: that, as a result of the abdominal wound and necessary resectioning of the Plaintiffs bowel, the Plaintiff suffered from extensive adhesions of the bowel which had caused a partial bowel obstruction.

injuries.description: the development of an incisional hernia
source: the development of an incisional hernia also supported the present existence of a partial blockage.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injury of muscle, fascia or tendon of abdomen, lower back or pelvis

injuries.description: other more minor injuries to the region of his right shoulder and neck.
source: other more minor injuries to the region of his right shoulder and neck.
injuries.icd_description: Superficial injury of shoulder or upper arm, unspecified

manifestations.description: uncontrollable urges to go to the toilet and defecated some 3-4 times a day
difficulty to sit for periods of greater than 15 minutes or so and had to stand or change his position as a result of abdominal wound pain or discomfort
abdominal pain, which he described also as wound pain, continuously
his sex life had deteriorated. It had reduced by about half as a result of this pain and discomfort.
a minor but continuing disability with his neck and right shoulder which causes him some inconvenience in activities such as dressing or lifting objects.

losses.description: Uncontrollable urges to go to the toilet and defecation 3-4 times a day; ongoing abdominal/wound pain; difficulty sitting for periods greater than 15 minutes, considerably restricting daily activities.

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life
losses.description: His sex life had deteriorated. It had reduced by about half as a result of this pain and discomfort.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Minor but continuing disability with his neck and right shoulder causing inconvenience in activities such as dressing or lifting objects.
